correctness.rationale: The statement fixes bounded coordinatewise real-linear maps on complex ell-two and uses the exact weakly-null norm-saturating definition. Scalar norm equality is |a|+|b|; finite truncation and weak-null coordinate tests prove essential norm r. A compact probability-measure limit supported on coefficient tail clusters is forced by equality of the squared norm average with \(r^2\) onto the local triangle-equality locus. Distinct tail coordinates realize every finite convex combination. Compact convex hulls and a sequence with prescribed cluster set prove shape completeness; constant coefficients give an exact maximum Hausdorff jump 2 with perturbation norm 2 epsilon. No infinite claim rests on finite random tests. The outer-contact reconstruction follows because a point on the extreme norm circle of a convex combination of points of the norm disk forces every positively weighted summand to equal that same point.

value.rationale: The main classification supplies an exact infinite-dimensional formula for a natural new real-linear essential-maximal invariant, a complete geometric realization theorem for every compact norm-circle-generated convex set, and a sharp norm-preserving collapse from disk to singleton under arbitrarily small perturbation. The paired ordinary essential-range formula exposes a genuine stability contrast, giving structural information not obtainable from mere compact convexity. The outer-contact reconstruction makes the classification computable directly from the ordinary essential range geometry within this operator class.
